target: Tukang itu membawa palu, obeng, dan gergaji di dalam kotak peralatannya.
english: That handyman carries a hammer, a screwdriver, and a saw in his toolbox.
grammar: Tukang + a trade names the worker: tukang kayu = carpenter, tukang ledeng = plumber.

target: Pinjam obeng kecil itu sebentar, saya mau mengencangkan sekrup di pintu lemari.
english: Lend me that small screwdriver for a moment; I want to tighten a screw on the cupboard door.

target: Paku di dinding ini sudah berkarat, jadi harus diganti dengan yang baru.
english: The nail in this wall has rusted, so it has to be replaced with a new one.
grammar: ber- + noun = 'to have/produce it': karat rust, berkarat rusty; debu dust, berdebu dusty.

target: Kalau bornya rusak, kita tidak bisa memasang rak kayu ini hari ini.
english: If the drill is broken, we can't put up this wooden shelf today.

target: Dia menaiki tangga untuk memperbaiki atap yang bocor sejak minggu lalu.
english: He climbs the ladder to fix the roof that has been leaking since last week.

target: Tolong ambilkan ember dan selang, saya mau mencuci mobil di halaman.
english: Please fetch the bucket and the hose; I want to wash the car in the yard.

target: Gergaji ini terlalu tumpul untuk memotong papan yang tebal itu.
english: This saw is too dull to cut that thick plank.

target: Sebelum mengecat tembok, tutup lantai dengan plastik supaya tidak kotor.
english: Before painting the wall, cover the floor with plastic so it doesn't get dirty.
grammar: One-syllable roots take menge-: cat, mengecat = to paint; cas, mengecas = to charge.

target: Kunci inggris ada di laci paling bawah, di sebelah kotak paku.
english: The wrench is in the bottom drawer, next to the box of nails.
grammar: Kunci inggris — literally 'English key' — is the everyday Indonesian word for a wrench.

target: Mesin jahit nenek masih berfungsi walaupun umurnya lebih dari empat puluh tahun.
english: Grandma's sewing machine still works even though it is more than forty years old.

target: Meja ini terbuat dari kayu jati, makanya berat sekali.
english: This table is made of teak wood; that's why it is so heavy.
grammar: terbuat dari + material = 'made of': terbuat dari kayu jati = made of teak wood.

target: Botol kaca lebih ramah lingkungan daripada botol plastik sekali pakai.
english: Glass bottles are more environmentally friendly than single-use plastic bottles.
grammar: sekali pakai = single-use, literally 'once use': botol plastik sekali pakai.

target: Pagar besi itu dicat ulang setiap dua tahun supaya tidak berkarat.
english: That iron fence is repainted every two years so it doesn't rust.

target: Kain dari pulau itu ditenun dengan tangan selama berminggu-minggu.
english: The cloth from that island is woven by hand over many weeks.

target: Sepatu kulit cepat rusak kalau sering kena hujan dan tidak pernah dirawat.
english: Leather shoes get ruined quickly if they often get rained on and are never cared for.

target: Rumah tradisional di desa itu dibangun dari bambu dan batu kali.
english: The traditional houses in that village are built from bamboo and river stone.

target: Sandal karet ini murah, ringan, dan cocok untuk musim hujan.
english: These rubber sandals are cheap, light, and right for the rainy season.

target: Tukang bangunan sedang mencampur semen dengan pasir di depan rumah kosong itu.
english: The construction workers are mixing cement with sand in front of that empty house.

target: Banjir tahun lalu lebih parah karena sungai penuh sampah plastik.
english: Last year's flood was worse because the river was full of plastic trash.

target: Jalan menuju bandara ditutup karena tergenang air setinggi lutut.
english: The road to the airport is closed because it is flooded with knee-deep water.
grammar: se- + adjective = 'as X as': setinggi lutut = knee-high, sebesar rumah = as big as a house.

target: Semakin lama musim kemarau, semakin sulit petani mendapatkan air untuk sawahnya.
english: The longer the dry season, the harder it is for farmers to get water for their rice fields.
grammar: semakin X, semakin Y = 'the more X, the more Y': semakin lama, semakin sulit.

target: Badai semalam menumbangkan pohon besar di depan kantor kami.
english: Last night's storm toppled the big tree in front of our office.

target: Kalau ada petir, jangan berteduh di bawah pohon yang tinggi.
english: If there's lightning, don't take shelter under a tall tree.
grammar: berteduh = to take shelter, from teduh (shade): berteduh di warung = shelter at a stall.

target: Angin kencang membuat penerbangan ke Lombok ditunda sampai besok pagi.
english: Strong winds made the flight to Lombok get postponed until tomorrow morning.

target: Kabut tebal turun setiap pagi di daerah pegunungan ini, jadi nyalakan lampu mobil.
english: Thick fog comes down every morning in this mountain area, so turn on the car's lights.

target: Gempa kecil sering terjadi di sini, jadi warga sudah terbiasa.
english: Small earthquakes often happen here, so the residents are already used to them.

target: Setelah hujan deras tiga hari, tanah di bukit itu longsor dan menutup jalan.
english: After three days of heavy rain, the ground on that hill slid and blocked the road.

target: Gelombang panas seperti ini berbahaya untuk orang tua dan anak kecil.
english: A heat wave like this is dangerous for the elderly and small children.

target: Atap rumah tetangga terbang ketika angin puting beliung lewat kemarin sore.
english: The neighbor's roof flew off when a whirlwind passed through yesterday afternoon.

target: Karena kekeringan, pemerintah mengirim truk air bersih ke desa-desa yang jauh.
english: Because of the drought, the government is sending clean-water trucks to the distant villages.
grammar: ke-...-an on adjectives names the state: kering dry, kekeringan drought; aman safe, keamanan safety.

target: Musim hujan tahun ini datang lebih awal daripada perkiraan.
english: This year's rainy season arrived earlier than predicted.

target: Nelayan tidak berani melaut karena ombak sangat tinggi minggu ini.
english: The fishermen don't dare go to sea because the waves are very high this week.

target: Kalau langit tiba-tiba gelap dan angin berhenti, biasanya hujan besar akan segera turun.
english: If the sky suddenly darkens and the wind stops, usually heavy rain will soon fall.

target: Keputusan sebesar ini tidak boleh diambil ketika kamu sedang marah.
english: A decision this big must not be made while you are angry.
grammar: ke-...-an also makes nouns from verbs: putus decide, keputusan decision; sempat, kesempatan chance.

target: Kesempatan seperti ini jarang datang dua kali, jadi pikirkan baik-baik.
english: An opportunity like this rarely comes twice, so think it over carefully.

target: Pengalaman bekerja di luar negeri mengubah cara saya melihat dunia.
english: The experience of working abroad changed the way I see the world.

target: Kepercayaan pelanggan lebih sulit dibangun daripada gedung bertingkat.
english: Customer trust is harder to build than a high-rise building.

target: Tanggung jawab terbesar seorang pemimpin adalah mendengarkan orang yang dipimpinnya.
english: A leader's biggest responsibility is listening to the people they lead.

target: Kegagalan pertama justru memberi saya keberanian untuk mencoba lagi.
english: The first failure actually gave me the courage to try again.
grammar: justru flips an expectation: 'actually, on the contrary'. Gagal justru membuat saya berani.

target: Kesabaran ibu saya hampir tidak ada batasnya kalau soal anak-anaknya.
english: My mother's patience has almost no limit when it comes to her children.

target: Perbedaan pendapat itu biasa; yang penting kita saling menghormati.
english: Differences of opinion are normal; what matters is that we respect each other.
grammar: saling + verb = 'each other': saling menghormati = respect each other. No object needed.

target: Persahabatan kami mulai dari kos yang sama lima belas tahun lalu.
english: Our friendship started from the same boarding house fifteen years ago.

target: Kebiasaan kecil seperti menabung sepuluh ribu sehari lama-lama terasa hasilnya.
english: A small habit like saving ten thousand a day — over time you feel the results.
grammar: lama-lama = 'eventually, over time': lama-lama terasa hasilnya = in time you feel the results.

target: Harapan orang tuanya sederhana: anak-anaknya hidup sehat dan jujur.
english: His parents' hope is simple: that their children live healthy and honest lives.

target: Kenyataan di lapangan sering berbeda dengan rencana yang dibuat di kantor.
english: The reality on the ground often differs from the plans made at the office.

target: Keberhasilan tim ini adalah hasil kerja keras semua orang, bukan satu orang saja.
english: This team's success is the result of everyone's hard work, not just one person's.
grammar: bukan negates nouns, tidak negates verbs and adjectives: bukan satu orang saja.

target: Kejujuran kasir itu dipuji manajer setelah dia mengembalikan dompet pelanggan.
english: The cashier's honesty was praised by the manager after she returned a customer's wallet.

target: Setiap keputusan ada risikonya; yang penting kamu siap dengan akibatnya.
english: Every decision has its risk; what matters is that you are ready for the consequences.

target: Kalau laporan ini tidak dikirim hari ini, masalahnya akan semakin rumit.
english: If this report isn't sent today, the problem will get more and more complicated.
grammar: Structures stack: kalau + passive di- + semakin — Kalau tidak dikirim, masalahnya semakin rumit.

target: Semakin sering kamu mengobrol dengan orang lokal, semakin cepat bahasamu berkembang.
english: The more often you chat with locals, the faster your language develops.

target: Meskipun sudah dilarang, masih ada orang yang membuang sampah ke sungai itu.
english: Even though it has been banned, there are still people who throw trash into that river.

target: Supaya tidak ketinggalan kereta, kami berangkat sebelum matahari terbit.
english: So as not to miss the train, we set off before sunrise.
grammar: ketinggalan = left behind, or 'to miss' transport: ketinggalan kereta = to miss the train.

target: Sambil menunggu hujan reda, kami mengobrol tentang rencana liburan tahun depan.
english: While waiting for the rain to ease, we chatted about next year's holiday plans.

target: Tiket yang dibeli lewat aplikasi bisa dibatalkan kalau penerbanganmu berubah.
english: Tickets bought through the app can be canceled if your flight changes.

target: Ketika listrik padam semalaman, baru terasa betapa pentingnya hal-hal kecil.
english: When the power was out all night, we finally felt how important the small things are.
grammar: betapa = 'how...!' in exclamations: betapa pentingnya = how important (it is).

target: Kalau kamu diundang makan di rumah orang, sebaiknya bawa buah tangan.
english: If you are invited to eat at someone's house, you should bring a small gift.
grammar: buah tangan = the small gift you bring when visiting — literally 'fruit of the hand'.

target: Rumah ini akan terasa semakin sepi setelah anak bungsu kami pindah ke luar kota.
english: This house will feel more and more quiet after our youngest child moves out of town.

target: Jangan sampai kesempatan emas ini lewat hanya karena kamu takut gagal.
english: Don't let this golden opportunity pass just because you are afraid to fail.
grammar: jangan sampai = 'don't let it get to the point that': jangan sampai terlambat = don't end up late.

target: Surat pengunduran dirinya sudah ditandatangani, jadi keputusan itu tidak bisa diubah lagi.
english: His resignation letter has been signed, so that decision can no longer be changed.

target: Walaupun gajinya lebih kecil, dia memilih pekerjaan yang dekat dengan keluarganya.
english: Even though the salary is smaller, she chose the job that is close to her family.

target: Lem ini kuat sekali; pegangan cangkir yang pecah pun bisa disambung lagi.
english: This glue is really strong; even a broken cup handle can be joined back together.
grammar: pun after a noun = 'even': cangkir yang pecah pun = even a broken cup.

target: Senter kecil selalu ada di tas saya kalau tiba-tiba mati lampu di jalan.
english: A small flashlight is always in my bag in case the lights suddenly go out on the road.

target: Baterai bor ini harus dicas dulu semalaman sebelum dipakai besok pagi.
english: This drill's battery has to be charged overnight first before it is used tomorrow morning.

target: Ukur dulu lebar jendelanya sebelum kamu memesan gorden baru.
english: Measure the width of the window first before you order new curtains.

target: Tukang ledeng datang memperbaiki keran yang bocor di kamar mandi belakang.
english: The plumber came to fix the leaking faucet in the back bathroom.

target: Helm dan sarung tangan wajib dipakai semua pekerja di lokasi pembangunan ini.
english: Helmets and gloves must be worn by all workers at this construction site.

target: Kacamata las melindungi mata dari percikan api ketika besi dipotong.
english: Welding goggles protect the eyes from sparks when iron is being cut.

target: Timbangan di dapur ini kurang akurat, jadi kuenya sering gagal.
english: The scale in this kitchen isn't very accurate, so the cakes often fail.

target: Perahu nelayan kecil itu hilang arah ketika kabut turun tiba-tiba.
english: That small fishing boat lost its way when the fog came down suddenly.

target: Sungai di belakang rumah meluap setiap kali hujan deras lebih dari dua jam.
english: The river behind the house overflows every time it rains hard for more than two hours.

target: Bawalah jas hujan tipis; cuaca pegunungan bisa berubah dalam hitungan menit.
english: Do bring a thin raincoat; mountain weather can change in a matter of minutes.
grammar: -lah softens a command into an invitation: Bawalah jas hujan = do bring a raincoat.

target: Karena jalur pendakian ditutup, pendaki harus turun lewat sisi timur gunung.
english: Because the climbing route is closed, hikers have to descend via the east side of the mountain.

target: Air sumur mulai surut karena hujan tidak turun selama dua bulan.
english: The well water is starting to drop because it hasn't rained for two months.

target: Petugas memperingatkan wisatawan agar tidak berenang ketika bendera merah dipasang.
english: Officers warn tourists not to swim when the red flag is put up.
grammar: agar = supaya = 'so that': memperingatkan agar tidak berenang = warn (them) not to swim.

target: Setelah badai, warga bergotong royong membersihkan jalan dari dahan yang patah.
english: After the storm, the residents worked together to clear the road of broken branches.
grammar: Gotong royong — neighbors pitching in together unpaid — is a named core value of village life.

target: Suhu di puncak bisa turun sampai lima derajat, jadi bawa jaket tebal.
english: The temperature at the summit can drop to five degrees, so bring a thick jacket.

target: Rapat besok akan menentukan apakah proyek ini dilanjutkan atau dihentikan.
english: Tomorrow's meeting will decide whether this project is continued or stopped.

target: Pengalamanmu di bagian layanan pelanggan cocok sekali untuk posisi baru ini.
english: Your experience in customer service suits this new position very well.

target: Data pelanggan tidak boleh dibagikan kepada pihak lain tanpa izin tertulis.
english: Customer data must not be shared with other parties without written permission.

target: Usul yang kamu tulis kemarin dibahas panjang dalam rapat direksi tadi pagi.
english: The proposal you wrote yesterday was discussed at length in the board meeting this morning.

target: Mesin fotokopi di lantai dua rusak lagi padahal baru diperbaiki minggu lalu.
english: The photocopier on the second floor is broken again even though it was just fixed last week.
grammar: padahal = 'and yet, even though': rusak lagi, padahal baru diperbaiki = broken again, yet just fixed.

target: Semakin tinggi jabatanmu, semakin besar tanggung jawab yang harus kamu pikul.
english: The higher your position, the bigger the responsibility you have to shoulder.
grammar: Responsibility is 'carried' in Indonesian: memikul tanggung jawab = to shoulder responsibility.

target: Karyawan baru itu cepat belajar karena tidak malu bertanya kepada siapa pun.
english: That new employee learns fast because he isn't embarrassed to ask anyone questions.

target: Gaji bukan segalanya; suasana kerja yang sehat juga penting untuk jangka panjang.
english: Salary isn't everything; a healthy work atmosphere also matters for the long term.

target: Nenek menyimpan semua foto lama di kotak kayu di bawah tempat tidurnya.
english: Grandma keeps all the old photos in a wooden box under her bed.

target: Adikku baru saja diterima di universitas negeri, dan seluruh keluarga bangga sekali.
english: My little sister was just accepted at a state university, and the whole family is very proud.

target: Setiap lebaran, rumah kami penuh dengan saudara yang pulang dari perantauan.
english: Every Eid, our house is full of relatives coming home from where they live and work far away.
grammar: Merantau = leaving home to make a living elsewhere; perantauan is that faraway place. A big life theme.

target: Ayah mengajari saya memperbaiki sepeda ketika saya masih kelas empat.
english: Dad taught me to fix a bicycle when I was still in fourth grade.

target: Resep sambal ini diturunkan dari generasi ke generasi di keluarga ibu saya.
english: This sambal recipe has been passed down from generation to generation in my mother's family.
grammar: diturunkan = 'passed down' (lit. lowered): resep diturunkan dari generasi ke generasi.

target: Kami bergiliran menjaga kakek di rumah sakit selama seminggu penuh.
english: We took turns watching over grandpa at the hospital for a full week.

target: Anak-anak dilarang main di dekat sumur tua di belakang kebun.
english: The children are forbidden to play near the old well behind the garden.

target: Sejak pindah ke kota, dia hanya bisa pulang menengok orang tuanya setahun sekali.
english: Since moving to the city, he can only go home to see his parents once a year.

target: Penginapan murah di dekat stasiun itu selalu penuh selama musim liburan.
english: The cheap lodgings near the station are always full during the holiday season.

target: Jangan lupa menukar uang sebelum naik kapal ke pulau kecil itu.
english: Don't forget to change money before boarding the boat to that small island.

target: Koper saya tertinggal di bus, tetapi sopirnya jujur dan mengembalikannya utuh.
english: My suitcase was left behind on the bus, but the driver was honest and returned it intact.

target: Peta kertas tetap berguna kalau sinyal telepon hilang di daerah terpencil.
english: A paper map is still useful if the phone signal disappears in a remote area.

target: Setiap sudut kota tua ini punya cerita yang menarik untuk ditelusuri.
english: Every corner of this old town has an interesting story to trace.

target: Ombak di pantai selatan terkenal kuat, jadi patuhi rambu peringatan di sana.
english: The waves on the south coast are famously strong, so obey the warning signs there.

target: Kalau kamu tersesat, cari masjid atau kantor polisi terdekat dan bertanyalah di sana.
english: If you get lost, find the nearest mosque or police station and ask there.

target: Warung di ujung gang itu menjual sarapan paling enak di kampung ini.
english: The stall at the end of that alley sells the tastiest breakfast in this neighborhood.

target: Gunting dapur ini khusus untuk memotong ayam, jangan dipakai untuk kertas.
english: These kitchen scissors are specifically for cutting chicken; don't use them for paper.

target: Setrika listrik itu tiba-tiba mati; mungkin kabelnya putus di dalam.
english: The electric iron suddenly died; maybe its cord is broken inside.

target: Cangkul dan sabit disimpan di gudang kecil di samping kandang ayam.
english: The hoe and the sickle are kept in the little shed next to the chicken coop.

target: Jarum dan benang selalu ada di rumah untuk menjahit kancing yang lepas.
english: There are always a needle and thread in the house for sewing on buttons that come loose.

target: Kompor gas lebih cepat panas, tetapi banyak orang desa masih memakai kayu bakar.
english: A gas stove heats up faster, but many village people still use firewood.

target: Termos ini menjaga air tetap panas sampai dua belas jam.
english: This thermos keeps water hot for up to twelve hours.

target: Layang-layang adik putus karena angin terlalu kencang sore itu.
english: Little brother's kite broke loose because the wind was too strong that afternoon.

target: Petani menutup tanaman cabainya dengan jaring supaya tidak rusak dihantam hujan es.
english: The farmer covers his chili plants with netting so they aren't ruined by pounding hail.

target: Krisis air membuat harga sayur di pasar naik hampir dua kali lipat.
english: The water crisis made vegetable prices at the market rise almost twofold.

target: Menurut ramalan cuaca, gelombang tinggi akan berlangsung sampai akhir pekan.
english: According to the weather forecast, the high waves will last until the weekend.

target: Kesehatan mental sama pentingnya dengan kesehatan badan, terutama untuk pekerja kantor.
english: Mental health is just as important as physical health, especially for office workers.

target: Rasa ingin tahu anak itu tidak pernah habis; setiap jawaban melahirkan pertanyaan baru.
english: That child's curiosity never runs out; every answer gives birth to a new question.

target: Kejutan ulang tahun itu hampir gagal karena adik tidak bisa menyimpan rahasia.
english: The birthday surprise almost failed because little brother couldn't keep a secret.

target: Kunci kebahagiaan keluarga itu sederhana: waktu bersama lebih berharga daripada hadiah mahal.
english: The key to family happiness is simple: time together is more valuable than expensive gifts.

target: Perasaan bersalah itu hilang setelah dia meminta maaf secara langsung.
english: That feeling of guilt disappeared after he apologized in person.

target: Keamanan penumpang menjadi alasan utama penerbangan malam itu dibatalkan.
english: Passenger safety was the main reason that night's flight was canceled.

target: Kalau cuaca semakin buruk, jadwal kapal bisa diubah tanpa pemberitahuan.
english: If the weather gets worse and worse, the boat schedule can be changed without notice.
grammar: Capstone combo: kalau + semakin + passive di- — Kalau cuaca semakin buruk, jadwal bisa diubah.

target: Pertumbuhan kota ini cepat sekali; sawah yang dulu luas kini menjadi perumahan.
english: This city's growth is very fast; rice fields that used to be wide are now housing estates.

target: Pendapat orang lain boleh didengarkan, tetapi keputusan akhir tetap di tanganmu.
english: Other people's opinions may be listened to, but the final decision stays in your hands.

target: Kesempatan magang di perusahaan itu dibuka lagi kalau kamu masih berminat.
english: The internship opening at that company is opening up again if you are still interested.
grammar: berminat = 'to be interested': masih berminat = still interested. The noun is minat.

target: Obeng plus dan obeng minus jangan sampai tertukar; ujungnya berbeda bentuk.
english: Don't let the Phillips and the flathead screwdrivers get mixed up; their tips are shaped differently.

target: Kayu jati semakin mahal karena semakin jarang pohon yang siap ditebang.
english: Teak wood is getting more expensive because trees ready to be felled are rarer and rarer.

target: Peringatan cuaca buruk disiarkan lewat pengeras suara di pelabuhan kecil itu.
english: The bad-weather warning is broadcast over the loudspeaker at that small harbor.

target: Kata orang, ada gula ada semut; di mana ada rezeki, orang pasti datang.
english: As people say, where there's sugar there are ants; wherever there's fortune, people are sure to come.
grammar: Proverb: 'where there's sugar, there are ants' — people gather wherever there's money or good fortune.

target: Sedikit demi sedikit, lama-lama menjadi bukit; tabunganmu akan tumbuh kalau kamu sabar.
english: Little by little, in time it becomes a hill; your savings will grow if you are patient.
grammar: Proverb: little by little it becomes a hill — small steady savings grow. The Indonesian 'slow and steady'.

target: Wajah anak kembar itu bagai pinang dibelah dua, sampai gurunya pun sering keliru.
english: The twins' faces are like a betel nut split in two; even their teacher often gets them mixed up.
grammar: Bagai pinang dibelah dua = 'like a betel nut split in two' — two people identical in looks.

target: Sekali mendayung, dua tiga pulau terlampaui: satu perjalanan, banyak urusan selesai.
english: One stroke of the paddle and two or three islands are passed: one trip, many errands done.
grammar: Proverb: one paddle stroke, two or three islands passed — one effort, many goals. 'Two birds, one stone.'

target: Air tenang menghanyutkan, jadi jangan remehkan orang pendiam di rapat itu.
english: Still water sweeps you away, so don't underestimate the quiet person in that meeting.
grammar: Proverb: calm water can sweep you away — the quiet ones may be the strongest. 'Still waters run deep.'

target: Berakit-rakit ke hulu, berenang-renang ke tepian; bersakit-sakit dahulu, bersenang-senang kemudian.
english: Raft upstream, then swim to the bank: endure hardship first, and enjoy yourself later.
grammar: A classic pantun every Indonesian knows: suffer first, enjoy later — hard work pays off in the end.

target: Tak kenal maka tak sayang, jadi mari saya perkenalkan kota kelahiran saya.
english: Unknown means unloved, so let me introduce my hometown.
grammar: Tak kenal maka tak sayang: 'unknown, unloved' — quoted whenever Indonesians introduce something new.

target: Di mana bumi dipijak, di situ langit dijunjung; hormatilah adat tempat kamu tinggal.
english: Where the earth is stood upon, there its sky is held up; do respect the customs of the place you live.
grammar: Proverb: where you stand, hold up that sky — follow local customs wherever you go. Core travel etiquette.

target: Nasi sudah menjadi bubur, jadi sekarang kita cari jalan keluarnya saja.
english: The rice has already become porridge, so now let's just look for the way out.
grammar: Nasi sudah menjadi bubur: the rice is already porridge — done is done; no crying over spilled milk.

target: Buah jatuh tidak jauh dari pohonnya; anak itu rajin persis seperti ibunya.
english: The fruit doesn't fall far from its tree; that child is diligent exactly like her mother.
grammar: Proverb: fruit falls near its tree — children take after their parents. A 'chip off the old block.'
